documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 1, Definitions
documents.text: In this Agreement, "Buyer" means Calder Works, "Supplier" means Harbor Electrical Ltd, "Goods" means the products Supplier sells to Buyer, and "Purchase Order" means Buyer's written order for Goods referring to this Agreement.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 2, Term
documents.text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for 5 years. It then renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives at least 60 days' written notice before the end of a term.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 3, Orders
documents.text: Buyer will order Goods by Purchase Order. Each Purchase Order incorporates this Agreement. Supplier shall confirm each Purchase Order within 5 business days. Terms on Supplier's quotations, acknowledgements or invoices that conflict with this Agreement do not apply.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 4, Pricing
documents.text: Prices are those stated in the Purchase Order and are firm for the life of each Purchase Order. A price may change only by a written amendment to this Agreement signed by both parties. A changed price applies to all Goods invoiced on or after the amendment's effective date, including Goods on open Purchase Orders, and to no Goods invoiced before it.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 5, Delivery
documents.text: Supplier shall deliver Goods to the location on the Purchase Order by the date it states. Partial deliveries are permitted; Supplier shall invoice only Goods actually delivered. Title and risk of loss pass to Buyer on delivery.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 6, Freight
documents.text: Freight may be invoiced as a separate line at Supplier's actual cost, not to exceed $100.00 per shipment. Freight above that amount is at Supplier's cost.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 7, Taxes
documents.text: Buyer purchases Goods for resale and has given Supplier a resale certificate. Supplier shall not invoice sales or use tax.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 8, Invoicing
documents.text: Supplier shall invoice each shipment separately, quoting the Purchase Order number, and send invoices to accounts payable at Calder Works. Each invoice shall list the Goods delivered, their quantities and unit prices, and any charge this Agreement allows.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 9, Payment
documents.text: Buyer will pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receiving it. Buyer may withhold payment of any amount it disputes in good faith, and shall tell Supplier which amount and why.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 10, Inspection and acceptance
documents.text: Buyer may inspect Goods within 14 days of delivery and reject any that do not conform. Payment is not acceptance. Supplier shall collect rejected Goods at its own cost.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 11, Warranty
documents.text: Supplier warrants that Goods will conform to their specifications and be free from defects in materials and workmanship for 24 months from delivery.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 12, Returns
documents.text: Buyer may return non-conforming Goods for credit or replacement, at Buyer's choice. Supplier shall issue a credit memo within 30 days of receiving returned Goods.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 13, Insurance
documents.text: Supplier shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence and shall provide a certificate of insurance on request.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 14, Indemnity
documents.text: Supplier shall defend and indemnify Buyer against third-party claims arising from defective Goods or from Supplier's negligence or breach of this Agreement.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 15, Limitation of liability
documents.text: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages. This limit does not apply to Supplier's indemnity obligations or to breach of confidentiality.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 16, Confidentiality
documents.text: Each party shall keep the other's confidential information confidential and use it only to perform this Agreement, for 5 years after it ends.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 17, Compliance
documents.text: Supplier shall comply with all laws applicable to the Goods and their delivery, including laws on product safety, labelling and export control.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 18, Audit
documents.text: Buyer may audit Supplier's records of charges invoiced under this Agreement, on 10 days' notice, for 3 years after each invoice.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 19, Force majeure
documents.text: Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control. A party so delayed shall notify the other promptly and resume performance as soon as it can.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 20, Termination
documents.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement on 60 days' written notice. Termination does not affect Purchase Orders already issued unless Buyer cancels them.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 21, Assignment
documents.text: Supplier may not assign this Agreement or subcontract its obligations without Buyer's written consent.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 22, Notices
documents.text: Notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and sent to Harbor Electrical Ltd, Attn: Contracts for Supplier and to Calder Works, Attn: Purchasing, for Buyer.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 23, Governing law
documents.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0001 (effective 2024-12-18) section 24, Entire agreement
documents.text: This Agreement, its amendments and each Purchase Order are the entire agreement between the parties about the Goods. They may be changed only in a writing signed by both parties.

documents.text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for 3 years. It then renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives at least 30 days' written notice before the end of a term.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 3, Orders
documents.text: Buyer will order Goods by Purchase Order. Each Purchase Order incorporates this Agreement. Supplier shall confirm each Purchase Order within 2 business days. Terms on Supplier's quotations, acknowledgements or invoices that conflict with this Agreement do not apply.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 4, Pricing
documents.text: Prices are those stated in the Purchase Order and are firm for the life of each Purchase Order. documents.text: Supplier shall deliver Goods to the location on the Purchase Order by the date it states. Partial deliveries are permitted; Supplier shall invoice only Goods actually delivered. Title and risk of loss pass to Buyer on delivery.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 6, Freight
documents.text: Freight may be invoiced as a separate line at Supplier's actual cost, not to exceed $225.00 per shipment. Freight above that amount is at Supplier's cost.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 7, Taxes
documents.text: Buyer purchases Goods for resale and has given Supplier a resale certificate. Supplier shall not invoice sales or use tax.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 8, Invoicing

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 9, Payment
documents.text: Buyer will pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days of receiving it. Buyer may withhold payment of any amount it disputes in good faith, and shall tell Supplier which amount and why.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 11, Warranty
documents.text: Supplier warrants that Goods will conform to their specifications and be free from defects in materials and workmanship for 12 months from delivery.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 12, Returns

documents.text: Supplier shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence and shall provide a certificate of insurance on request.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 14, Indemnity
documents.text: Supplier shall defend and indemnify Buyer against third-party claims arising from defective Goods or from Supplier's negligence or breach of this Agreement.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 15, Limitation of liability
documents.text: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages. This limit does not apply to Supplier's indemnity obligations or to breach of confidentiality.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 16, Confidentiality

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 17, Compliance

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 18, Audit

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0005 (effective 2024-09-22) section 20, Termination

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 1, Definitions
documents.text: In this Agreement, "Buyer" means Calder Works, "Supplier" means Pioneer Packaging Corp, "Goods" means the products Supplier sells to Buyer, and "Purchase Order" means Buyer's written order for Goods referring to this Agreement.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 2, Term
documents.text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for 5 years. It then renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives at least 90 days' written notice before the end of a term.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 3, Orders
documents.text: Buyer will order Goods by Purchase Order. Each Purchase Order incorporates this Agreement. Supplier shall confirm each Purchase Order within 5 business days. Terms on Supplier's quotations, acknowledgements or invoices that conflict with this Agreement do not apply.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 4, Pricing
documents.text: Prices are those stated in the Purchase Order and are firm for the life of each Purchase Order. A price may change only by a written amendment to this Agreement signed by both parties. A changed price applies to all Goods invoiced on or after the amendment's effective date, including Goods on open Purchase Orders, and to no Goods invoiced before it.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 5, Delivery
documents.text: Supplier shall deliver Goods to the location on the Purchase Order by the date it states. Partial deliveries are permitted; Supplier shall invoice only Goods actually delivered. Title and risk of loss pass to Buyer on delivery.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 6, Freight
documents.text: Freight may be invoiced as a separate line at Supplier's actual cost, not to exceed $150.00 per shipment. Freight above that amount is at Supplier's cost.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 7, Taxes
documents.text: Buyer purchases Goods for resale and has given Supplier a resale certificate. Supplier shall not invoice sales or use tax.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 8, Invoicing
documents.text: Supplier shall invoice each shipment separately, quoting the Purchase Order number, and send invoices to accounts payable at Calder Works. Each invoice shall list the Goods delivered, their quantities and unit prices, and any charge this Agreement allows.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 9, Payment
documents.text: Buyer will pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receiving it. Buyer may withhold payment of any amount it disputes in good faith, and shall tell Supplier which amount and why.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 10, Inspection and acceptance
documents.text: Buyer may inspect Goods within 14 days of delivery and reject any that do not conform. Payment is not acceptance. Supplier shall collect rejected Goods at its own cost.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 11, Warranty
documents.text: Supplier warrants that Goods will conform to their specifications and be free from defects in materials and workmanship for 12 months from delivery.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 12, Returns
documents.text: Buyer may return non-conforming Goods for credit or replacement, at Buyer's choice. Supplier shall issue a credit memo within 30 days of receiving returned Goods.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 13, Insurance
documents.text: Supplier shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and shall provide a certificate of insurance on request.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 14, Indemnity
documents.text: Supplier shall defend and indemnify Buyer against third-party claims arising from defective Goods or from Supplier's negligence or breach of this Agreement.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 15, Limitation of liability
documents.text: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages. This limit does not apply to Supplier's indemnity obligations or to breach of confidentiality.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 16, Confidentiality
documents.text: Each party shall keep the other's confidential information confidential and use it only to perform this Agreement, for 5 years after it ends.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 17, Compliance
documents.text: Supplier shall comply with all laws applicable to the Goods and their delivery, including laws on product safety, labelling and export control.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 18, Audit
documents.text: Buyer may audit Supplier's records of charges invoiced under this Agreement, on 10 days' notice, for 3 years after each invoice.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 19, Force majeure
documents.text: Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control. A party so delayed shall notify the other promptly and resume performance as soon as it can.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 20, Termination
documents.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement on 90 days' written notice. Termination does not affect Purchase Orders already issued unless Buyer cancels them.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 21, Assignment
documents.text: Supplier may not assign this Agreement or subcontract its obligations without Buyer's written consent.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 22, Notices
documents.text: Notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and sent to Pioneer Packaging Corp, Attn: Contracts for Supplier and to Calder Works, Attn: Purchasing, for Buyer.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 23, Governing law
documents.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

documents.title: Master Supply Agreement MSA-2025-0020 (effective 2025-04-19) section 24, Entire agreement
documents.text: This Agreement, its amendments and each Purchase Order are the entire agreement between the parties about the Goods. They may be changed only in a writing signed by both parties.
